newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Health buys Signature Home Care.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Health buys Signature Home Care.

text.p: Integrated Health Services Inc said that it has acquired Signature Home Care Group Inc, headquartered in Irving, Texas.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
With annualized revenues of over $60 million, Signature Home Care is a full service home health care company with 22 branch locations in five states.
The company said that in the last few months it has completed acquisitions of home health care and hospice companies with revenues in excess of $110 million, including Signature.
The company said its annualized home health revenues prior to these acquisitions was $115-$130 million.
